row.evidence: Pendo's 'Set up SCIM in Pendo' article says SCIM is available for Premium customers or as an add-on (contact your Pendo representative), and requires SAML enforced and Okta or Microsoft Entra ID.
row.notes: Status unchanged (gated). Plans changed since June: the pricing page now lists Free (500 MAUs), Base, Core and Ultimate (all 'Request pricing', priced by MAU volume and modules, not per seat), plus Novus (free beta); the June names Pulse/Premium are gone from the pricing page, though the help centre still says SCIM is for 'Premium' customers or an add-on. June's team plan 'Free' is replaced by Base (cheapest paid tier); June's '~$48K+/yr' median contract figure came from a third-party source and is dropped. SAML SSO is itself an additional paid service and must be enforced before SCIM. SCIM supports only Okta (OIN app with Create, Update, Deactivate, Group Push) and Microsoft Entra ID (non-gallery app; the gallery app is SAML only). Enabling SCIM disables manual invite/delete in Pendo. No JIT. The Engage API manages guides, segments, metadata and analytics visitors, not Pendo users.

plans.name: Base
plans.notes: SAML SSO is an additional paid service; SCIM is for 'Premium' customers or an add-on. The pricing page does not map either to Base, Core or Ultimate.

auth.token_source: Settings > Organization Settings > SSO > SCIM Settings (toggle SCIM Provisioning; Pendo shows the Base URL and API Key; Regenerate API Key link)

endpoints.notes: Endpoint list not published; users and groups are provisioned. Tenant URL ends in /v2.

operations.notes: Update is documented; PUT vs PATCH is not stated.

deprovision.notes: Okta 'Remove and deactivate users'. Pendo is priced by MAU, not seats. Users not in assigned IdP groups lose access to the subscription.

attributes.notes: Required attributes from the Entra setup guide; no full schema published.

roles.how: Group-to-role mapping: IdP groups are assigned roles/permissions per subscription in Organization Settings > SSO > Subscription Access.

limitations.text: Only Okta and Microsoft Entra ID are supported IdPs.
SAML must be enforced on the subscription first; SAML SSO is itself a paid service.
Once SCIM is enabled, teammates cannot be added or removed manually in Pendo; Pendo teams must be turned off before configuring SCIM.
The Entra gallery app has no provisioning; a separate non-gallery app is required. Nested groups are not supported.
Individual users of a pushed group are not visible in the Pendo app.

user_api.notes: The Engage API (integration keys) covers guides, segments, metadata, visitors/accounts of the customer's app, reports and bulk deletion; its Admin section only verifies integration keys. No endpoint for managing Pendo users (teammates) or roles was found.

okta.notes: OIN functionality marks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate and Group Push.

entra.notes: SCIM to Entra uses a separate non-gallery app with Pendo's base URL.

fallbacks.notes: Without SCIM, admins add users manually; with SAML required, adding a user grants access without accepting an invite. A user/role CSV can be downloaded (export, not import).
